title: eludite.terminal.resize input
description: Resize a terminal's grid to `cols` columns and `rows` rows: the PTY's size changes, so programs (and `tput cols`, `$COLUMNS` after the next prompt) see it. The Terminal window sets each visible terminal's size from its own; a resize the window then overrides holds only while the terminal is not shown. For agents, class execute decided by the solution policy's `terminal.run`.

terminal.description: The terminal: its id from eludite.terminal.open or eludite.terminal.list (`term1`, `term2`, ...). Default: the active terminal of the Terminal window (the one last opened or selected).
